verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents in-product AI over customer data. Cortex Analyst lets business users ask natural-language questions and get direct answers without writing SQL, and Cortex AI Functions run LLM analytics on text and images inside Snowflake. The CoWork "Ask anything" experience and the Cortex Code agent extend this. Missing for 10: documented proactive or unprompted insight and suggestion generation (the only anomaly detection shown is cost-focused and in preview), and independent or hands-on corroboration of answer quality.
